description: Run one read-only DuckDB SELECT over a Parquet file, available as table `data`; join more files by passing `tables` ({name: artifact_id}, up to 7 besides data), e.g. a GL against a bank statement. Supports aggregates, window functions, CTEs, DESCRIBE data and SUMMARIZE data. Up to 1000 rows are returned; `truncated` says if more matched. Writes, file access and multiple statements are rejected. Example: SELECT region, sum(units) FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call, paid via x402.

artifact_id.description: artifact_id returned by an earlier convert_to_parquet call.
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

format.description: json rows (default), a Markdown table, or CSV text.
format.title: Format

sql.description: One DuckDB SELECT statement over table `data`.
sql.title: Sql

tables.description: Extra tables for joins: {name: artifact_id}, up to 7 besides data. The main input is `data`.
tables.title: Tables

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input file. Preferred for anything over ~3 MB.
url.title: Url

name: query_parquet

truncated.description: True when more rows matched than were returned.
truncated.title: Truncated

title: Query Parquet with SQL
